entries.title: I Chronicles 25:1
segments: Moreover David and the captains of the host set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of them that did the work according to their service was:

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:2
segments: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asharelah, the sons of Asaph, under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied after the order of the king.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:3
segments: Of Jeduthun; the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun with the harp, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Jehovah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:4
segments: Of Heman; the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:5
segments: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:6
segments: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of Jehovah, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God; Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:7
segments: And the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in singing unto Jehovah, even all that were skilful, was two hundred fourscore and eight.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:8
segments: And they cast lots for their offices, all alike, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:9
segments: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah; he and his brethren and sons were twelve:

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:10
segments: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:11
segments: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:12

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:13

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:15
segments: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:16
segments: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:17
segments: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:18
segments: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brethren, twelve:

segments: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
